subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should forced cookie refresh extend `cache clear --cookies` with an explicit app-mediated re-import mode, or remain an app-only action until the CLI can safely perform the signed browser-import workflow?
rationale: The standalone command overlaps an existing CLI contract, while browser and Keychain entitlement constraints prevent it from reliably delivering the immediate refresh promised by its name. citeturn744149view0turn924610view0

options.title: App-mediated refresh
options.body: Extend the existing CLI surface so an explicit refresh mode requests the signed app to import using provider metadata and atomically replace the cache.

options.title: Clear-only alias
options.body: Accept `cookie refresh` as a convenience alias that clears the cache and requires a later app refresh despite overlapping existing behavior.

options.title: App UI only
options.body: Defer the CLI command and expose re-import in provider settings until a safe noninteractive app bridge exists.

recommendation.title: App-mediated refresh
recommendation.body: Extend the existing CLI surface so an explicit refresh mode requests the signed app to import using provider metadata and atomically replace the cache.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CLI command ownership makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the permanent command and app boundary.
